correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated the legal faces and all 48 automorphisms. A spanning tree and triangular relations in the covering complex kill every edge generator of pi_1, independently of the submitted Morse calculation. The three specified edge-fixing elements generate the group, so Armstrong's theorem gives a simply connected ordinary orbit space. Barycentric flags have strictly ordered sizes and no inversions; the orbit cells therefore have the signed deletion boundaries. Independent descending-flag enumeration gave (35,316,1101,1718,1200,300); the integral boundaries compose to zero. Separate integer reductions of each boundary using only unit pivots gave ranks (34,282,819,899,300), with all nonzero integral elementary divisors equal to one. Thus each image is saturated and the quotient homology is free with ranks (1,0,0,0,1,0). Hurewicz supplies a sphere map representing a generator in degree four; homological Whitehead makes it a homotopy equivalence. This proves neither homeomorphism nor a Borel quotient claim.
